lines.text: Same list as cigarettes? Processed meat is on it too.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪm lˈɪst az sˌɪɡəɹˈɛts? pɹˈəʊsɛst mˈiːt ɪz ˌɒn ɪt tˈuː.

lines.text: All three are in the top group of the World Health Organization's cancer agency. That group ranks how sure the evidence is, not how big the risk.
lines.phonemes: ˈɔːl θɹˈiː ɑːɹ ɪnðə tˈɒp ɡɹˈuːp ɒvðə wˈɜːld hˈɛlθ ˌɔːɡɐnaɪzˈeɪʃənz kˈansəɹ ˈeɪdʒənsi. ðat ɡɹˈuːp ɹˈaŋks hˌaʊ ʃˈʊə ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns ɪz, nˌɒt hˌaʊ bˈɪɡ ðə ɹˈɪsk.

lines.text: Tanning beds give off mostly UVA, the long rays. In big, powerful units it may be ten to fifteen times as strong as midday sun.
lines.phonemes: tˈanɪŋ bˈɛdz ɡˈɪv ˈɒf mˈəʊstli jˌuːviːˈeɪ , ðə lˈɒŋ ɹˈeɪz. ɪn bˈɪɡ, pˈaʊəfəl jˈuːnɪts ɪt mˈeɪ biː tˈɛn tə fˈɪftiːn tˈaɪmz az stɹˈɒŋ az mˌɪddˈeɪ sˈʌn.

lines.text: When beds joined the list, the clearest signal came from people who started young. Pooled studies found that people who started using beds before thirty-five had a melanoma risk raised by more than half.
lines.phonemes: wˌɛn bˈɛdz dʒˈɔɪnd ðə lˈɪst, ðə klˈiəɹɪst sˈɪɡnəl kˈeɪm fɹɒm pˈiːpəl hˌuː stˈɑːtɪd jˈʌŋ. pˈuːld stˈʌdiz fˈaʊnd ðat pˈiːpəl hˌuː stˈɑːtɪd jˈuːzɪŋ bˈɛdz bɪfˌɔː θˈɜːtifˈaɪv had ˈeɪ mˌɛləˈnəʊmə ɹˈɪsk ɹˈeɪzd baɪ mˈɔː ðɐn hˈɑːf.

lines.text: Whole countries acted. By twenty sixteen, every Australian state had banned commercial tanning beds, and Brazil banned them too.
lines.phonemes: hˈəʊl kˈʌntɹiz ˈaktɪd. baɪ twˈɛnti sˈɪkstiːn, ˈɛvɹɪ ɒstɹˈeɪliən stˈeɪt had bˈand kəmˈɜːʃəl tˈanɪŋ bˈɛdz, and bɹɐzˈɪl bˈand ðˌɛm tˈuː.

lines.text: Those long rays go through the top layer of skin, which on most of us is about as thin as paper.
lines.phonemes: ðəʊz lˈɒŋ ɹˈeɪz ɡˌəʊ θɹuː ðə tˈɒp lˈeɪəɹ ɒv skˈɪn, wˌɪtʃ ˌɒn mˈəʊst əv ˌʌs ɪz ɐbˌaʊt az θˈɪn az pˈeɪpə.

lines.text: The sun joined that list years before the beds. Same list as cigarettes means the same certainty, not the same harm.
lines.phonemes: ðə sˈʌn dʒˈɔɪnd ðat lˈɪst jˈiəz bɪfˌɔː ðə bˈɛdz. sˈeɪm lˈɪst az sˌɪɡəɹˈɛts mˈiːnz ðə sˈeɪm sˈɜːtənti, nˌɒt ðə sˈeɪm hˈɑːm.

lines.text: Next: more skin questions, answered with the evidence.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: mˈɔː skˈɪn kwˈɛstʃənz, ˈansəd wɪððɪ ˈɛvɪdəns.
